integrity: The formulas are proved by exhaustive characterization of all geodesics, not by numerical extrapolation. The numerical verifier is a finite corroboration only; an existing scalar result is expressly credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Simple unweighted graphs with a complete core, at least three hubs, and positive integer pendant multiplicities; no extension claimed to paths of length greater than one or to arbitrary core graphs. A highly relevant 2026 corona-product paper was unavailable in full text for priority comparison; independent science and comprehensive priority review remain unperformed.
title: Complete edge-general-position and facet enumerators for cliques with pendant bundles
